## Load in packages

```{r}
#| label: setup 
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(readr)
```

## Importing Data

1.  Import the data

```{r}
# Response Variable
life_exp <-read_csv("Data/lex.csv")   

# Predictor Variables 
CO2 <-read_csv("Data/co2_cons.csv")
gdp <-read_csv("Data/gdp_pcap.csv")
HDI <-read_csv("Data/hdi_human_development_index.csv")
poverty<-read_csv("Data/number_of_people_in_poverty.csv")
internet <- read_csv("Data/internet_users.csv")
traff_death <- read_csv("Data/traffic_deaths.csv")
sanitation <- read_csv("Data/basic_sanitation_overall.csv")
gapminder_2025<-read_csv("Data/gapminder_2025.csv") # QUALITATIVE (regions)
democracy <-read_csv("Data/democracy2020.csv")   # QUALITATIVE (Yes/NO)
UN_mem <- read_csv("Data/un_member_status.csv")  # QUALITATIVE (mem/not mem)
```

## Wrangling Data

TODO: 1. Combine all the data into a large dataset

*NOTE:* We will use the last recorded year for the datasets that do not have a 2025 entry.

```{r}
# Join Data Files
data_lst<- list(select(life_exp, geo,'2025'), select(CO2, geo,'2022'), select(gdp, geo, '2025'), select(HDI, geo,'2023'), select(poverty, geo, '2025'), select(internet, geo, '2024'), select(traff_death, geo, '2023'), select(sanitation, geo, '2024'), select(UN_mem, geo, '2022'), select(gapminder_2025, geo, world_4region))

Full_2025<-democracy
for (dataset in data_lst){  
  Full_2025 <- Full_2025|>
    full_join(dataset, by="geo")
}

```

```{r}
Full_2025<-Full_2025|>
  rename( #rename columns for clarity
         LifeExp = `2025.x`,
         CO2=`2022.x`,
         GDP=`2025.y`,
         Poverty = `2025`,
         HDI= `2023.x`,
         Internet = `2024.x`,
         Traffic_Deaths = `2023.y`,
         Sanitation = `2024.y`,
         UN_member = `2022.y`
         ) 
```

## Export Data as CSV
```{r}
 # read data as csv
write_csv(Full_2025, "Data/FullData_2025.csv")
```
